mapper.select: select count(*) + 1 from evaluation_batch_requests where job_type = 'RECALCULATION'
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_requests (batch_id, job_type, target_condition_json, request_user_id, request_status, request_id) values (#{batchId}, #{jobType}, #{targetConditionJson}::jsonb, #{requestUserId}, 'COMPLETED', #{requestId})

insert into score_calculation_generations (evaluation_material_id, formula_version_id, generation_no, before_score, after_score, calculated_score, rule_version_id, calculation_basis_json, recalculation_batch_id, request_id, calculated_by) values (#{target.evaluationMaterialId}, #{target.formulaVersionId}, #{target.nextGenerationNo}, #{target.beforeScore}, #{target.afterScore}, #{target.afterScore}, #{target.ruleVersionId}, jsonb_build_object( 'sourceAchievementId', #{target.sourceAchievementId}, 'formulaVersionId', #{target.formulaVersionId}, 'formulaCode', #{target.formulaCode}, 'beforeScore', #{target.beforeScore}, 'afterScore', #{target.afterScore}, 'basis', 'evaluation_score_rules base_score with formula bounds' ), #{batchId}, #{requestId}, #{requestUserId})
mapper.update: update evaluation_materials set calculated_score = #{target.afterScore}, request_id = #{requestId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{requestUserId} where evaluation_material_id = #{target.evaluationMaterialId} and deleted_yn = 'N' and material_status = '인증'
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_results (batch_id, job_type, total_count, success_count, failure_count, excluded_count, error_detail_json, request_id) values (#{batchId}, #{jobType}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{excludedCount}, '[]'::jsonb, #{requestId}) on conflict (batch_id) do update set total_count = excluded.total_count, success_count = excluded.success_count, failure_count = excluded.failure_count, excluded_count = excluded.excluded_count, error_detail_json = excluded.error_detail_json, request_id = excluded.request_id
